auto-compact.title: Auto-Compact (replace max_turn)
auto-compact.description: Delete maxTurns hard cap and replace with context-window-triggered auto-compaction. Pi-mono-style: estimate tokens, summarize older history when over threshold, keep recent turns. Adds CAS for concurrent supplement safety and reactive retry for context-overflow errors. Removes max-turn budget from prompt text entirely.

ac-compactor-core.title: task-3: Compactor core (cut-point + summarize + CAS)
ac-compactor-core.description: New file history/Compactor.kt (~180 LOC). Pi-mono-style cut-point: walk back accumulating tokens, snap forward to nearest safe boundary (any Message item or FunctionCall; never FunctionCallOutput). Summarize discarded prefix via LLM call (no tools, ~5K maxTokens). New history layout: [USER_INTENT(currentGoal), COMPACTION_SUMMARY, ...kept]. CAS swap via HistoryManager.replaceAllIfRevision. Rethrow CancellationException. forceCompactNow() for reactive path (shrunken keepRecentTokens).
acceptCriteria: Compactor class with maybeCompact(currentGoal, history) and forceCompactNow(currentGoal, history)

Output history starts with [USER_INTENT(Goal: <currentGoal>), COMPACTION_SUMMARY, ...kept]; previous COMPACTION_SUMMARY (if any) is replaced not duplicated

AgentTurnRunner no longer calls isFinalTurn or emits FINAL TURN warning. Eval-only safety net: if config.evalTurnBudget != null && turnCount >= it, stop with Error.
